[Melee] I want to main Falco. What are some tech for Falco that is incredibly important to know?

I responded about SH lasering on that other comment, but there a few more things you should start to learn. Falco is incredibly fast, people think it's his shine that makes him so good but you need to master his movement before you can master his shine. Learn his wavedash speeds, learn how high his hop is (he has to highest full jump in the game), and more importantly learn how to jump out of shine. Falco's standard combo is pillaring. A Falco pillar is essentially just dair -> shine -> dair -> shine etc while following your opponents DI. Dair and Bair are your most important aerials to learn at first and will probably get you most of your kills. In the neutral you're looking to stop opponents approaches with lasers while pushing towards them, and then you want to pop them up with a dair. Like I said above, a dair leads to a shine which leads to the rest of your combo. On a character with a weight like Marth, you can combo dair to f smash after maybe 40% (don't quote me on that %). Understand that Falco's recovery is AWFUL, especially compared to Fox's, so you really need to focus on stage position and try hard not to over extend combos.

Falco's to watch would probably be Zhu, PP, and Mango. Zhu plays a super solid Falco and I recommend you watching videos of him playing against average players. Unfortunately Zhu gets beat by top players but when you watch him fight someone who has a lower skill level, he is amazing. PPMD has a Falco style that is super efficient, and his movement is so good that his Falco stands out among the rest. Mango plays a little unorthodox, but you can watch him to see how many options the character has beyond pillaring.

All in all you're picking up a super hard character, but he is also super good. A lot of people think the space animals are cheap because of shine (it comes out on frame 1) but they're wrong. the people who complain about spacies are the people who can't play them. Not only are they the two of the best characters in the game, but they are by far the hardest to master. Have fun, practice a lot. Get comfortable with the character and then worry about the technical stuff.
